title: Bionic Woman
description:
S1 E3 — Angel of Mercy
Posing as a nurse, Jaime accompanies a daring helicopter pilot (Andy Griffith) to Central America to rescue an ambassador's wife.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S1 E4 — A Thing of the Past
The picture of a protected witness (Donald O'Connor), working as a school bus driver, appears in the paper after he saves a girl.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S1 E5 — Claws
Left in charge of a wild-animal ranch, Jaime must protect a tame lion from ranchers who suspect it of killing livestock.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S1 E6 — The Deadly Missiles
Jaime and Steve team up to stop a missile attack on Los Angeles launched from within the United States.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S1 E7 — Bionic Beauty
Jaime goes undercover in a beauty pageant Oscar suspects is linked to threats against national security.

title: Bionic Woman
description:
S1 E8 — Jaime's Mother
Jaime sees a woman (Barbara Rush) resembling her dead mother, who Oscar admits was a Department of Defense agent.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E5 — Halloween Knight
Flu-sufferer Bonnie sees a man in a gorilla suit strangle a woman, but no one will believe her.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E6 — KITT vs. KARR
An auto mechanic recovers and repairs KITT's prototype, unaware of its evil capacities.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E7 — Fuzz Lady
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E6 — The Rabbit Who Ate Las Vegas
The kidnapping of a gambler leads to a mobster (Charles Cioffi) and then to a $100,000 price on Hannibal's head.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E7 — The Out-of-Towners
The team aids Manhattan shopkeepers victimized by mobsters extorting protection money; guest Yaphet Kotto.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E8 — Holiday in the Hills
Fanatical mountain men attack after the team crash-lands deep in the Appalachians; guests Edward Winter, Bill McKinney.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E13 — A Nice Place to Visit
While attending a friend's funeral, the A-Team encounters a crazed mountain clan. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.
